card.title: PS4 Power Rail Impedance and Short Diagnosis

claims.statement: APU health can be checked by measuring impedance on capacitors near the APU.
claims.quote: Measure the impedance of the capacitors to check health of the APU

claims.statement: If +12V rail is shorted, lift the main coil to isolate the shorted area.
claims.quote: If +12V is shorted, you can lift this coil to narrow shorted area

procedure: Lift main +12V coil if a short is detected on the main rail.
Remove coils one by one in parallel power stages to identify shorted MOSFETs.
card.caveats: Low impedance readings on modern APU rails are normal; ensure you are not misinterpreting low resistance as a short.
